d:
Jharkhand ke saraykela jile men skuli chhatron dvara kendriy raksha rajy mantri evan sthaniy vidhayak ka virodh, skuli bachchon ne sarak jamkar diya dharna, kendriy raksha aur rajy mantri evan jhamumo vidhayak ke khilaph lagaya hay hay ka nara
Jharkhand ke saraykela jile men dashkon ki mang par jamdih relve ovar brij ka udghatan karne aae kendriy raksha rajy mantri evan sthaniy jhamumo vidhayak ko jhelna para skuli bachchon ka virodha.
Udghatan ke phite ko hath se tora,kaimre se bachkar nikle kendriy raksha rajy mantri anchal adhikari ne di pure mamle ki jankari.
